title: thymus acinos var. incanotomentosus
intro: Thymus acinos var. incanotomentosus, commonly known as Creeping Thyme, is a low-growing, spreading herbaceous plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and stress, promoting relaxation, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Thymus acinos var. incanotomentosus include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid. The health benefits of this plant include relieving anxiety and insomnia, reducing fever, and soothing skin irritations, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas, essential oils, and topical remedies.
